ui.prompt: Use-case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, plausible PC tactical game UI design proposal for SternenBürgerchen, wide 16:9 composition. Reference image 1 is a WORLD STYLE AND MAP COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY; image 2 is a MATERIAL/PALETTE reference ONLY. These are not edit targets. Soft illustrative industrial science-fiction, warm rust canyon, cream modular buildings, slate teal roofs, yellow safety accents, simple Kenney-like readable forms. No copying existing branded spacecraft. View is a game screenshot with native-looking crisp flat UI controls over an isometric tactical map; no monitor/frame/desk. This is an illustrative mockup, no gameplay claims. UI text in German, generous readable text, sane whitespace. Do not use microprint, neon HUD ornaments, noisy grunge, chart dashboards, currencies, build menus, individual soldier movement controls, pause/speed controls or hidden enemy information. The mission runs in real time without pause. Only currently visible contacts may be shown; conceal distant areas. Do not copy the square tile grid in the reference; leave grid off (the graphics candidate uses hex coordinates). Use the SAME example mission and state for variants A and B: objective 'Relais sichern'; Fireteam ALPHA 4/4 selected, FTL Mara, BEWEGEN order to a visible waypoint not yet executed; Fireteam BRAVO 4/4 holding. The team has four persons in a summary, portraits are read-only details. Exactly these four action labels 'Bewegen', 'Nehmen', 'Verteidigen', 'Flankieren'. Distinct icons respectively arrow to location, flag in hexagon, shield, path bending around cover. Separate stance selector 'Vorsichtig · Normal · Aggressiv' and fire-rule row 'Feuerregel: Feuer erwidern'. The planned command area clearly says 'Ziel gewählt' and button 'Plan ausführen'; it is not a pause button. One contextual status explanation, example 'ALPHA · Bereit für Befehl'. Dropship summary 'Dropship · Bereit' and 'Landezone wählen'. Top header 'STERNENBÜRGERCHEN' and 'EINSATZ · ROSTGRENZE'. Small visible caption 'UI-ENTWURF · BEISPIELWERTE'. VARIANT A / KOMMANDODECK: restrained dark opaque slate panels #151c21 and #252d33, off-white text #edf3f6, cyan #63d1d2 for command planning, yellow #f2c94c ONLY for selected fireteam outline, green ready badge plus word. Thin 6px corners, tiny cream hardware accents, no visible screws needed. Broad map at least 65 percent of screenshot. Slim top objective bar. Left lower vertical compact ALPHA/BRAVO cards, a focused commander dock across bottom containing the four large labeled order buttons, next the stance/fire-rule rows, target summary and Plan ausführen. Compact right top mission-control card for dropship/LZ. Right bottom event feed at most two short lines. Clear map/team/order hierarchy. A genuinely appealing finished game UI concept with consistent typography, clear unambiguous controls and rich warm world.

Use-case: ui-mockup. Create one gorgeous practical wide 16:9 PC game UI concept screen for SternenBürgerchen called EINSATZTAFEL, showing the existing FOB preparation flow. Reference 1 only establishes rust-world setting, reference 2 establishes cream modular industrial construction, slate-teal panels and yellow safety rails. Neither is an edit target. Soft illustrative Kenney-like industrial SF forms, warm rust canyon beyond the hangar, friendly utilitarian modular architecture, no existing branded spacecraft. Native-looking crisp flat dark slate interface #151c21 with cream #edf3f6 type, cyan command/accent #63d1d2 and selected yellow #f2c94c; readable German text and sane spacing. Main header 'STERNENBÜRGERCHEN' · 'FOB · EINSATZVORBEREITUNG'; small caption 'UI-ENTWURF · BEISPIELWERTE'. Persistent process strip 'Heimatbasis → Transfer → FOB → Boarding → Einsatz', FOB highlighted. UI/STAGING FIRST: this is NOT free-roaming base gameplay or a building game. Left third: operator roster list 'Einsatzkräfte' with four compact readable portrait rows with name and existing generic loadout role labels; use names Mara, Jona, Kira, Nils, statuses Bereit and Zugewiesen. Center: ALPHA team card with FTL Mara, four assigned members and status '4/4 zugewiesen', explicit 'Zuweisen' and 'Entfernen' as alternatives to drag-and-drop. A small right-side loadout drawer for selected member with two weapon slots labeled 'Waffe 1' and 'Waffe 2', armor 'Rüstung', 'Gewicht' (illustrative bar, no invented numeric rule). Right half/lower main area: visually pleasing hangar staging vignette with one generic compact cream-and-teal dropship on yellow safety-bordered pad, four abstract operator slots next to it, NOT stacks obscuring the spacecraft. Clearly labeled 'Dropship · Bereit', 'Boarding' and a consistent compact progress bar, small pilot assignment 'Pilot zugewiesen'. Primary action 'Boarding starten'. Keep preparation, boarding and departure distinct; no fabricated claim that clicking accepts a server request. Sidebar has visible 'Loadout', 'Fireteams', 'Transport' access. No economy, crafting, tech trees, pause controls, fake charts, microtext or huge holograms. Good hierarchy: assign team → inspect loadout → board transport. Keep all true buttons and text flat and legible, illustrations only in the hangar and portraits.

icons.prompt: Use-case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated UI icon candidate for the PC tactical SF game SternenBürgerchen. Transparent background with real alpha, square composition, centered motif occupying about 76 percent of the canvas, generous equal transparent margins, absolutely no words/letters/numbers, no captions, no watermark, no rectangular background, no button plate, no outer circular badge. Clear readable silhouette at 32px, restrained flat enamel / softly shaded cut-paper industrial pictogram, front facing orthographic emblem, large simple cream #edf3e7 surfaces, slate petrol #385a60 structural parts and one restrained cyan #63d1d2 accent. Very subtle illustrated edge shading, no cast shadow spreading outside icon, no noisy texture, no glow, no photorealism, no gold, no busy microdetail. This belongs with cream modular stations, teal roofs and yellow safety lines in an illustrated rust-world setting. Uniform visual weight and consistent light from upper left. All components connected or clearly grouped. Meaning must work without color. MOTIF / MOVE COMMAND: one bold bent directional arrow traveling from a small round origin on lower left toward one simple map location pin on upper right. Exactly one arrowhead, clear negative space between arrow shaft and pin. Communicates going to a selected location, not attack, undo, defend or loading. Keep the pin simple and broad, no shield, no sword.
